name: workspace-search-category
goal: Keep desktop source search within its supported route categories

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Main 50b02f29 (#55) widens shared SearchEntry to Platforms; desktop typecheck fails because workspace routes accept source categories only.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Standard workspace-search.test.ts checked identity and revisions, but not a listed entry whose shared category becomes unsupported. Desktop typecheck was absent from the upstream category change checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 1973c040e sealed red bcd0b45f0c0627e67d9feb96d2819a12920b550f78a547c98c878e52dfb00579: unsupported Platforms route is returned; 4 cases pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Validate the desktop category at the existing identity boundary. Keep accepted source routes and reject Platforms; require desktop typecheck and workspace search tests when shared category unions change.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 1234e2c07 preserves entry identity and checks supported categories. Existing workspace search and route tests pass; desktop typecheck has zero errors.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 1234e2c07 sealed green b791d7a0c536cc885b43d008218ac30159e2b0effd1be3fd2b54af372cbcf7ba: same 5 tests pass, unchanged command and environment.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated snapshot at 1234e2c07: restoring the 1973c040e adapter fails the unchanged null-route assertion (exit 1); restoring the repair passes all 5 tests (exit 0).

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Search/navigation browser 34 passed; search/routes units 17 passed; desktop types 0 errors. Contract/ownership guard 14 passed; units check no errors. Imported Reports 138 unit, 113 entity browser and 76 shell browser passed. Final committed game captures follow; full CLI/native deferred.
